# The public module-level surface of `recoverage` as of v3.0.0, the last release
# that shipped with no public name removed and no entry written about it.
#
# One `module::NAME` per line, read by `tests/test_release.py`
# (`TestPublicSurfaceChangesAreRecorded`). A name in this file the package no
# longer defines has to appear in a `Removed` or `Breaking` group of
# `CHANGELOG.md`, or the suite fails. A name the package adds is not in this
# file and does not have to be: adding to the surface is what a minor does.
#
# The file is deliberately not regenerated by the suite. Replacing a line after
# a recorded removal is the release commit's move, made beside the changelog
# entry that records the removal, so the two cannot disagree.
